items.Sentence: Raw wastewater or influent enters at the headworks where it passes through a comminutor (grinder), prior to being discharged to an unlined complete-mix aerated lagoon.
The existing WWTF is an aerated lagoon system designed to remove BOD and total suspended solids (TSS).
From the complete-mix aerated lagoon, the effluent is discharged to one of six unlined oxidation lagoons, where the effluent percolates into the underlying soil/substrate and evaporates.
Currently unlined evaporation/percolation ponds and land application to ~ 32 acres of pasture
At the entrance to the WWTF, there is an old trickling filter and clarigester that have not been operational since 1985 when the WWTF was last updated.
